# Security Policy

## Scope

This repository contains only **documentation** (a Jekyll static site). It does not contain application code, credentials, or infrastructure configuration for the Genkō platform.

If you have found a security vulnerability in the **Genkō application** at [getgenko.com](https://getgenko.com), please follow the responsible disclosure process below.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub Issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report security issues by emailing the Genkō team directly at the contact address listed on [getgenko.com](https://getgenko.com). Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof-of-concept (if applicable)
- Any suggested mitigations

You can expect an acknowledgment within 72 hours. We will keep you informed as the issue is investigated and resolved.

## Documentation issues

If you find a documentation error that could mislead users in a security-relevant way (for example, incorrect guidance about access controls or permissions), please open a [GitHub Issue](../../issues/new/choose) using the **Docs Feedback** template.
